status: the columns run on the lake model as its sha256 in producer.files gives it
evidence: A one-dimensional lake model (biosphere/ecology/lake.py as corrected after the independent review of 18 October 2026; checked by its own tests against analytic diffusion, convective and wind deepening, reaeration and conduction-limited ice) run with lake_oxygen's physics and scenarios on each basin's own hypsography from LOLA at 16 pixels a degree with the held seas' 0.14 g/kg, forced by the GCM's own 3-day means at the basin's T21 water cells: the lock's weather moved to 301 K by the lake kinds study's Setting301, which interpolates between the design case and the hot world's test by the ground's temperature and so mixes two physics. The construction reproduces the waters' oxygen study's 300 K figures exactly. Below the mixed layer the wind's share of its energy flux sets the dissipation (Earth lakes' 0.3%, bracketed 0.2-0.4%), which Osborn's rule turns into a diffusivity in every column but two; at Procellarum's and Ingenii's typical cells Shih et al.'s (2005) regimes of the buoyancy Reynolds number, as Bouffard & Boegman (2013) carry them to lakes, take its place (lake_oxygen/mixing_forms.py's swap inside the process), mixing the energetic deep water less. Oxygen demand is lake_oxygen's bounded scenarios from Earth's lakes. Every deep column passes the ten-year record 80 times from a warm start (variants 30 times from their basin's central column) in coarse steps, then passes it at the analysis step until lake_oxygen's settle test passes or ten passes, before the decade that is saved; eight of the 52 deep columns do not settle there, and analysis_step names the way each one's decade leans. A column has no horizontal circulation; these basins' Lake numbers lie far under 1 and the large ones span tens of internal Rossby radii, so that the wind drives Ekman transport, upwelling along the shores and Kelvin and Poincare waves, which a column does not hold: each basin is run at its typical and its coldest cell as bounds, and the effect of exchange is a screen. No lunar sea has been measured.
reading_rule: Oxygen in g/m3 (mg/L), temperatures in C, depths in m. Quantile lists are the 10th, 50th and 90th percentiles. answers gives each basin's deep water: the typical column at the central wind share, the variants at its typical cell keyed typical_<variant> (the share's bracket wind_share_low and _high; at the two largest basins lake_number, fixed_dissipation, solute_none or oligotrophic_physics, and shih_bouffard, the other form of the deep mixing), and the coldest column; their oxygen is the saved decade's, after the passes at the analysis step, each trophic state's central column (surface-renewal transfer, demand fixed by supply, a 4-day labile pool) with its bracket across the other transfer and the pool's 2 and 7 days. analysis_step says whether those passes settled and, where they did not, which way the decade leans (reading; oxygen_is and age_is, upper or lower values). decade_overturns counts the saved decade's lunar cycles in which the mixed layer reached the bottom layer, decade_overturns_a_century the same as a rate; overturns_a_century and the long_ figures are the coarse passes' last half, in 4-step means, which leave more oxygen in the deep water than the analysis step. seas_wide weighs each basin by the share of the seas it stands for, one column of each basin to a view, naming the unsettled columns it takes; forms sets the two forms of the deep mixing side by side where both ran, with their range. deep and variants hold each column's full figures, keyed basin_column[_variant]: spin_up gives the coarse passes' long state and the passes at the analysis step; profiles gives figures from the daily columns: the deepest tenth's age since the water last touched the surface, the time-mean shares of the volume and the floor under hypoxic (2) and anoxic (0.5) water, the nights' mixing and the temperature at the sills to the other basins of the sea; lake_number the Lake number by the day's warm layer and the month's thermocline; diffusivity the form of the deep mixing; budget the heat and oxygen errors in lake_oxygen's measures, the heat rebuilt from the saved decade beside the saved figure. pans are the shelves and bays, a 3 m and a 10 m pan with eutrophic physics, their nights from sunset to sunrise, beside lakes_pans, the lakes' 3 m pans at 301 K; pans_bracket sets a few of them beside their runs under the fixed dissipation. bounds compare a basin's typical and coldest columns, with the screen of its deep water under exchange, read from the saved decade's overturns (screen) and the coarse passes' (screen.coarse), the deepest tenth's reference demand and the factor the warm kinetics would raise it by. connections say whether a basin's water at its sill is ever colder than its neighbour's deep water. rotation gives each basin's internal Rossby radius from its typical column's stratification (wave in m/s) against its size. saturation.at_301k follows lake_oxygen's saturation() at the 301 K share. The saved columns are listed in research/runs/sea_oxygen/columns.json with their sha256s.

setting.cells_rule: typical: the water cell whose mean 301 K surface temperature lies nearest the area-weighted median of the basin's cells; coldest: the cell, holding at least 1,000 km2 of the basin, whose coldest 3-day mean is the lowest; one column where the two coldest 3-day means lie within 0.5 K

cell_pressure_atm.note: the GCM's surface pressure at the cells, over T21's truncated orography; its sea-level pressure there is 1.199-1.200 atm

selection.rule: The four seas over 100,000 km2 are divided into basins at 250 m, each taking the shallower water nearest it through the sea; other bodies are their own basins. Run: every basin of at least 100,000 km2 (the largest seas and the deepest point); the basin nearest each pole among those of at least 10,000 km2; and the crater seas' representative, the body of 10,000-100,000 km2 within 10 degrees of the crater seas' median latitude whose deepest point lies nearest their median deepest point, both by area over the bodies under 100,000 km2; and the shallow seas' representative, the largest region of a large sea whose deepest point lies above 500 m.
